+function contractHarness(completion: "local_verified" | "pr_opened" = "local_verified") {
+  const h = new Harness();
+  const actions = completion === "local_verified" ? ["build", "verify"] : ["build", "verify", "commit", "push", "open_pr"];
+  const task = intent(["docs/readme.md"], actions);
+  const frozen = freezeDeliveryContract({ schema_version: 2, contract_id: "contract-1", task_id: task.task_id,
+    canonical_repo: task.workspace_path, mode: "implement", base_head: "1".repeat(40), goal: task.goal,
+    required_checks: [{ id: "tests", registry_ref: deliveryCheckReference("pnpm test") }], review_policy_ref: "profile:test",
+    requested_completion: completion, allowed_paths: ["docs/readme.md"], requested_actions: actions,
+    budget_ref: "policy", policy_digest: SHA_B, publication_scope: completion === "local_verified" ? { mode: "none" } : {
+      mode: "review_pr", hostname: "github.com", repository: "owner/repo", remote: "origin", base_ref: "main", head_ref: "codex/run-1" }, merge_authority: { mode: "none" } });
+  h.policy.delivery_contract = frozen;
+  h.localResults = [{ ...localSuccess(["docs/readme.md"]), delivery_receipt: { path: "/tmp/receipt.json", digest: SHA_A } }];
+  h.ports.verifyContractReceipt = async () => { h.calls.push("verifyContractReceipt"); };
+  h.ports.writeContractCompletionReceipt = async (input) => { h.calls.push(`completion:${input.achievedCompletion}`); return { path: "/tmp/completion.json", digest: SHA_C }; };
+  h.ports.openPullRequest = async () => { h.calls.push("openPullRequest"); return { pushedCommit: "6".repeat(40), pr: { number: 42, url: "https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42", reused: false } }; };
+  return { h, task: { ...task, contract_sha256: frozen.digest } };
+}
+describe("V2 contract completion ceilings", () => {
+  it("completes local verification without commit, push, merge or deploy", async () => {
+    const { h, task } = contractHarness();
+    const result = await h.engine().start(task);
+    expect(result.status).toBe("completed");
+    expect(result.run.context.achieved_completion).toBe("local_verified");
+    expect(h.calls).toContain("completion:local_verified");
+    expect(h.calls).not.toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["commit"]));
+    expect(h.calls).not.toContain("deliverGit");
+    expect(h.calls).not.toContain("openPullRequest");
+    expect(h.calls.filter(x => x.startsWith("deploy:"))).toEqual([]);
+  });
+  it("opens a PR through the existing publisher port and never invokes merge delivery", async () => {
+    const { h, task } = contractHarness("pr_opened");
+    let result = await h.engine().start(task);
+    if (result.status === "needs_approval") result = await h.engine().resume(task.autonomy_run_id, signDecision(result.approval_request!));
+    expect(result.status, JSON.stringify(result)).toBe("completed");
+    expect(h.calls).toContain("commit");
+    expect(h.calls).toContain("openPullRequest");
+    expect(h.calls).not.toContain("deliverGit");
+    expect(result.run.context.achieved_completion).toBe("pr_opened");
+  });
+  it("refuses boolean local success without a host receipt", async () => {
+    const { h, task } = contractHarness(); h.localResults = [localSuccess(["docs/readme.md"])];
+    const result = await h.engine().start(task);
+    expect(result.status).not.toBe("completed");
+    expect(h.calls).not.toContain("writeCandidateProof");
+    expect(h.calls).not.toContain("commit");
+  });
+  it("revalidates the candidate before side effects and fails closed on changed bytes", async () => {
+    const { h, task } = contractHarness(); let reads = 0;
+    h.ports.verifyContractReceipt = async () => { if (++reads > 1) throw new Error("candidate changed"); };
+    const result = await h.engine().start(task);
+    expect(result.status).not.toBe("completed"); expect(reads).toBe(2);
+    expect(h.calls).not.toContain("commit");
+  });
+});
+
+it("rejects a legacy projection resumed with a new V2 contract policy", async () => {
+  const { h } = contractHarness(); const contract = h.policy.delivery_contract!;
+  delete h.policy.delivery_contract;
+  await h.engine().start(intent(["docs/readme.md"]));
+  h.policy.delivery_contract = contract;
+  await expect(h.engine().resume("run-1")).rejects.toThrow("delivery_contract_resume_mismatch");
+});
+it("rejects a persisted V2 projection resumed without its frozen policy contract", async () => {
+  const { h, task } = contractHarness(); await h.engine().start(task); delete h.policy.delivery_contract;
+  await expect(h.engine().resume("run-1")).rejects.toThrow("delivery_contract_resume_mismatch");
+});

FILE packages/cli/src/delivery-contract-host.ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { execFile } from "node:child_process";
import { constants } from "node:fs";
import { lstat, mkdir, open, readFile, readlink, realpath, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { isAbsolute, join, relative } from "node:path";
import { promisify } from "node:util";
import { assertDeliveryContractPaths, assertFrozenDeliveryContract, deliveryCheckReference, deliveryContractDigest, verifyDeliveryContractReceipt } from "@osstack/core";
import { DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2, type DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2, type DeliveryReceiptReferenceV2, type FrozenDeliveryContractV2 } from "@osstack/protocol";
import type { CommandAudit, ReviewArtifact } from "@osstack/loop";

const exec = promisify(execFile);
export const deliveryBytesDigest = (bytes: string | Buffer) => createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
export async function deliveryGit(workspace: string, args: string[]): Promise<string> {
  const safeArgs = args[0] === "diff" ? ["diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", ...args.slice(1)] : args;
  return (await exec("git", ["-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", ...safeArgs], {
    cwd: workspace, encoding: "utf8", timeout: 30000, maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
    env: { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0" },
  })).stdout;
}
export async function captureDeliveryCandidate(workspace: string, baseHead: string): Promise<DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2> {
  const head = (await deliveryGit(workspace, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])).trim();
  const tree = (await deliveryGit(workspace, ["write-tree"])).trim();
  const diff = await deliveryGit(workspace, ["diff", "--cached", "--binary", baseHead, "--"]);
  return { base_head: baseHead, head, tree_id: tree, diff_digest: deliveryBytesDigest(diff) };
}
export async function persistDeliveryHostRecord(root: string, value: unknown): Promise<DeliveryReceiptReferenceV2> {
  await mkdir(root, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  const canonicalRoot = await realpath(root);
  const body = `${JSON.stringify(value)}\n`;
  const digest = deliveryBytesDigest(body);
  const path = join(canonicalRoot, `${digest}.json`);
  try { await writeFile(path, body, { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 }); }
  catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "EEXIST" || await readFile(path, "utf8") !== body) throw error;
  }
  return { path, digest };
}
export async function readDeliveryHostRecord(root: string, ref: DeliveryReceiptReferenceV2): Promise<unknown> {
  const canonicalRoot = await realpath(root);
  if (!isAbsolute(ref.path) || (await lstat(ref.path)).isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error("delivery_receipt_path_invalid");
  const canonicalPath = await realpath(ref.path);
  const local = relative(canonicalRoot, canonicalPath);
  if (local.startsWith("..") || isAbsolute(local) || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}\.json$/.test(local)
    || local !== `${ref.digest}.json`) throw new Error("delivery_receipt_path_invalid");
  const handle = await open(canonicalPath, constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
  try {
    const info = await handle.stat();
    if (!info.isFile() || info.size > 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("delivery_receipt_size_invalid");
    const body = Buffer.alloc(info.size + 1);
    const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(body, 0, body.length, 0);
    if (bytesRead !== info.size) throw new Error("delivery_receipt_size_changed");
    const actual = body.subarray(0, bytesRead);
    if (deliveryBytesDigest(actual) !== ref.digest) throw new Error("delivery_receipt_digest_mismatch");
    return JSON.parse(actual.toString("utf8")) as unknown;
  } finally { await handle.close(); }
}
export function buildDeliveryVerificationReceipt(input: {
  frozen: FrozenDeliveryContractV2; runId: string; runKind: "guarded-local" | "guarded-git";
  candidate: DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2; commands: readonly CommandAudit[]; reviews: readonly ReviewArtifact[];
  builderAgentId: string; builderIdentity: Record<string, unknown>; workspaceStateDigest: string; contextReceiptRefs?: readonly DeliveryReceiptReferenceV2[];
}) {
  const { contract, digest } = assertFrozenDeliveryContract(input.frozen);
  const review = input.reviews[0];
  if (!review || input.reviews.some((item) => item.verdict !== "approved") || input.builderIdentity.evidence_source !== "reported"
    || review.runtime_identity.evidence_source !== "reported") throw new Error("delivery_reported_review_missing");
  const checks = input.commands.map((command, index) => {
    const registryRef = deliveryCheckReference(command.command);
    return { id: contract.required_checks.find((check) => check.registry_ref === registryRef)?.id ?? `host:${index}`,
      registry_ref: registryRef, command_digest: registryRef.slice(7), exit_code: command.exit_code, duration_ms: command.duration_ms };
  });
  return DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2.parse({ schema_version: 2, source: "osstack_loop_host", run_id: input.runId,
    task_id: contract.task_id, run_kind: input.runKind, contract_digest: digest, policy_digest: contract.policy_digest,
    candidate: input.candidate, workspace_state_digest: input.workspaceStateDigest, checks, review: { policy_ref: contract.review_policy_ref, verdict: review.verdict,
      builder_agent_id: input.builderAgentId, reviewer_agent_id: review.reviewer_agent_id,
      builder_provider: input.builderIdentity.provider_id, builder_model: input.builderIdentity.model_id,
      reviewer_provider: review.runtime_identity.provider_id, reviewer_model: review.runtime_identity.model_id,
      identity_source: "reported", artifact_digest: deliveryContractDigest(input.reviews) },
    observed_at: new Date().toISOString(), context_receipt_refs: input.contextReceiptRefs ?? [] });
}
/** Trusted host port: load its own immutable record and re-sample actual Git state.
 * A committed candidate may change HEAD, but its verified tree and base-relative diff must not change. */
export async function verifyPersistedDeliveryReceipt(input: {
  root: string; ref: DeliveryReceiptReferenceV2; frozen: FrozenDeliveryContractV2; runId: string; workspace: string; expectedHeads?: readonly string[];
}) {
  const raw = await readDeliveryHostRecord(input.root, input.ref);
  const receipt = DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2.parse(raw);
  const current = await captureDeliveryCandidate(input.workspace, input.frozen.contract.base_head);
  if (receipt.candidate.head !== input.frozen.contract.base_head
    || !(input.expectedHeads ?? [input.frozen.contract.base_head]).includes(current.head)) throw new Error("delivery_candidate_head_mismatch");
  if (current.tree_id !== receipt.candidate.tree_id || current.diff_digest !== receipt.candidate.diff_digest)
    throw new Error("delivery_candidate_changed_after_verification");
  if ((await snapshotDeliveryWorkspace(input.workspace, input.frozen.contract.base_head)).digest !== receipt.workspace_state_digest)
    throw new Error("delivery_workspace_changed_after_verification");
  // Unstaged/untracked edits were never part of the reviewed tree.
  if ((await deliveryGit(input.workspace, ["diff", "--name-only"])).trim()
    || (await deliveryGit(input.workspace, ["ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard"])).trim())
    throw new Error("delivery_candidate_has_unverified_changes");
  verifyDeliveryContractReceipt(input.frozen, raw, { runId: input.runId, candidate: { ...current, head: receipt.candidate.head },
    policyDigest: input.frozen.contract.policy_digest });
  return { receipt, current };
}

async function deliveryConfig(workspace: string): Promise<string> {
  const config = await deliveryGit(workspace, ["config", "--local", "--null", "--list"]);
  if (config.split("\0").some(entry => /^filter\..*\.(?:clean|smudge|process)\n/i.test(entry)))
    throw new Error("delivery_git_filter_unsupported");
  return config;
}
async function snapshotDeliveryWorkspace(workspace: string, baseHead: string) {
  await deliveryConfig(workspace);
  const flags = (await deliveryGit(workspace, ["ls-files", "-v", "-z"])).split("\0").filter(Boolean);
  if (flags.some(entry => /^[a-zS]/.test(entry))) throw new Error("delivery_hidden_index_flags");
  const tracked = (await deliveryGit(workspace, ["diff", "--no-renames", "--name-only", "-z", baseHead, "--"])).split("\0").filter(Boolean);
  const untracked = (await deliveryGit(workspace, ["ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"])).split("\0").filter(Boolean);
  const ignored = (await deliveryGit(workspace, ["ls-files", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard", "-z"])).split("\0").filter(Boolean).sort();
  const paths = [...new Set([...tracked, ...untracked])].sort();
  const allFiles = [...new Set([...flags.map(entry => entry.slice(2)), ...paths])].sort();
  if (allFiles.length + ignored.length > 100000) throw new Error("delivery_candidate_too_many_files");
  const changes: Array<{ path: string; digest: string | null; mode: number | null }> = [];
  let bytes = 0;
  for (const path of allFiles) {
    const absolute = join(workspace, path);
    const info = await lstat(absolute).catch(error => { if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return undefined; throw error; });
    if (!info) { changes.push({ path, digest: null, mode: null }); continue; }
    if (!info.isFile() && !info.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error("delivery_candidate_file_invalid");
    bytes += info.size;
    if (bytes > 64 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("delivery_candidate_too_large");
    let body: string | Buffer;
    if (info.isSymbolicLink()) body = await readlink(absolute);
    else {
      const file = await open(absolute, constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
      try {
        const opened = await file.stat();
        if (!opened.isFile() || opened.size !== info.size) throw new Error("delivery_candidate_file_changed");
        body = Buffer.alloc(info.size + 1);
        const { bytesRead } = await file.read(body, 0, body.length, 0);
        if (bytesRead !== info.size) throw new Error("delivery_candidate_file_changed");
        body = body.subarray(0, bytesRead);
      } finally { await file.close(); }
    }
    changes.push({ path, digest: deliveryBytesDigest(body), mode: info.isSymbolicLink() ? 0o120000 : info.mode & 0o111 ? 0o100755 : 0o100644 });
  }
  return { digest: deliveryContractDigest({ baseHead, changes, ignored }), paths, ignored };
}
/** One invocation owns its pre-build baseline and exact check/review snapshot.
 * The same snapshot must survive staging and receipt capture; it is not re-baselined. */
export function createDeliveryVerificationFence(frozen: FrozenDeliveryContractV2) {
  const baselines = new Map<string, { ignored: Set<string>; config: string }>();
  const verified = new Map<string, string>();
  const sample = async (workspace: string) => {
    const baseline = baselines.get(workspace);
    if (!baseline) throw new Error("delivery_verification_baseline_missing");
    if ((await deliveryGit(workspace, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])).trim() !== frozen.contract.base_head)
      throw new Error("delivery_candidate_base_changed");
    if (await deliveryConfig(workspace) !== baseline.config) throw new Error("delivery_git_config_changed");
    const snapshot = await snapshotDeliveryWorkspace(workspace, frozen.contract.base_head);
    if (snapshot.ignored.some(path => !baseline.ignored.has(path))) throw new Error("delivery_new_ignored_file");
    assertDeliveryContractPaths(frozen, snapshot.paths);
    return snapshot.digest;
  };
  const fence = async (workspace: string): Promise<() => Promise<void>> => {
    verified.delete(workspace);
    const before = await sample(workspace);
    return async () => {
      if (await sample(workspace) !== before) throw new Error("delivery_candidate_changed_during_verification");
      verified.set(workspace, before);
    };
  };
  return Object.assign(fence, {
    prepare: async (workspace: string) => {
      const snapshot = await snapshotDeliveryWorkspace(workspace, frozen.contract.base_head);
      baselines.set(workspace, { ignored: new Set(snapshot.ignored), config: await deliveryConfig(workspace) });
      verified.delete(workspace);
    },
    assertVerified: async (workspace: string) => {
      const digest = verified.get(workspace);
      if (!digest || await sample(workspace) !== digest) throw new Error("delivery_reviewed_candidate_changed");
      return digest;
    },
  });
}

FILE packages/cli/src/delivery-contract-host.test.ts
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { chmod, mkdir, readFile, rm, stat, symlink, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { createScratchDir, deliveryCheckReference, freezeDeliveryContract } from "@osstack/core";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { deliveryGit, createDeliveryVerificationFence, persistDeliveryHostRecord, readDeliveryHostRecord } from "./delivery-contract-host.js";

let root: string;
beforeEach(async () => { root = await createScratchDir("tests", "contract-host"); });
afterEach(async () => { await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); });
it("reads only digest-bound local host files and rejects tampering, traversal and symlinks", async () => {
  const directory = join(root, "receipts");
  const ref = await persistDeliveryHostRecord(directory, { trusted: "host" });
  await expect(readDeliveryHostRecord(directory, ref)).resolves.toEqual({ trusted: "host" });
  const outside = join(root, `${ref.digest}.json`); await writeFile(outside, await readFile(ref.path));
  await expect(readDeliveryHostRecord(directory, { ...ref, path: outside })).rejects.toThrow("path_invalid");
  await rm(ref.path); await symlink(outside, ref.path);
  await expect(readDeliveryHostRecord(directory, ref)).rejects.toThrow("path_invalid");
  await rm(ref.path); await writeFile(ref.path, '{"trusted":"forged"}\n');
  await expect(readDeliveryHostRecord(directory, ref)).rejects.toThrow("digest_mismatch");
});
it("fences tracked and new files without altering the candidate index", async () => {
  const workspace = join(root, "repo"); await mkdir(workspace);
  const git = (args: string[]) => execFileSync("git", args, { cwd: workspace, encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
  git(["init", "-b", "main"]); await mkdir(join(workspace, "src")); await writeFile(join(workspace, "src/a.txt"), "old");
  await writeFile(join(workspace, "private.txt"), "outside scope");
  git(["add", "."]); git(["-c", "user.name=test", "-c", "user.email=test@example.invalid", "commit", "-m", "seed"]);
  const base = git(["rev-parse", "HEAD"]);
  const frozen = freezeDeliveryContract({ schema_version: 2, contract_id: "contract", task_id: "task", canonical_repo: workspace,
    mode: "implement", base_head: base, goal: "change", required_checks: [{ id: "test", registry_ref: deliveryCheckReference("pnpm test") }],
    review_policy_ref: "profile:test", requested_completion: "local_verified", allowed_paths: ["src"], requested_actions: ["build", "verify"],
    budget_ref: "policy", policy_digest: "a".repeat(64), publication_scope: { mode: "none" }, merge_authority: { mode: "none" } });
  const marker = join(root, "external-executed"); const hook = join(root, "hook.sh");
  await writeFile(hook, `#!/bin/sh\nprintf hacked > '${marker}'\n`); await chmod(hook, 0o700);
  git(["config", "core.fsmonitor", hook]); git(["config", "diff.external", hook]);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, "src/a.txt"), "host-read");
  await deliveryGit(workspace, ["diff", "--binary", "HEAD"]);
  await deliveryGit(workspace, ["ls-files", "-v"]);
  await expect(stat(marker)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "ENOENT" });
  git(["config", "--unset", "core.fsmonitor"]); git(["config", "--unset", "diff.external"]);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, "src/a.txt"), "old");
  const verifier = createDeliveryVerificationFence(frozen); await verifier.prepare(workspace);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, "src/a.txt"), "candidate");
  const fence = await verifier(workspace);
  expect(git(["diff", "--cached", "--name-only"])).toBe("");
  await expect(fence()).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  git(["add", "-A"]);
  await expect(verifier.assertVerified(workspace)).resolves.toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, "src/a.txt"), "changed during check");
  await expect(fence()).rejects.toThrow("changed_during_verification");
  await expect(verifier.assertVerified(workspace)).rejects.toThrow("reviewed_candidate_changed");
  await writeFile(join(workspace, "src/new.txt"), "new candidate");
  const newFence = await verifier(workspace);
  await writeFile(join(workspace, "src/new.txt"), "changed new candidate");
  await expect(newFence()).rejects.toThrow("changed_during_verification");
  git(["mv", "private.txt", "src/private.txt"]);
  await expect(verifier(workspace)).rejects.toThrow("path_outside_scope");
});

FILE packages/core/src/delivery-contract.ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import {
  DeliveryContractV2, FrozenDeliveryContractV2, DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2,
  type DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2,
} from "@osstack/protocol";

export function deliveryContractDigest(value: unknown): string {
  const canonical = (input: unknown): unknown => {
    if (Array.isArray(input)) return input.map(canonical);
    if (input && typeof input === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(input)
      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b, "en")).map(([key, val]) => [key, canonical(val)]));
    return input;
  };
  return createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(canonical(value))).digest("hex");
}
export function deliveryCheckReference(command: string): string {
  return `sha256:${createHash("sha256").update(command).digest("hex")}`;
}
/** Canonicalization is pure: callers must separately resolve workspace/policy authority. */
export function freezeDeliveryContract(value: unknown): FrozenDeliveryContractV2 {
  const parsed = DeliveryContractV2.parse(value);
  const contract = { ...parsed,
    required_checks: [...parsed.required_checks].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id, "en")),
    allowed_paths: [...new Set(parsed.allowed_paths)].sort(),
    requested_actions: [...new Set(parsed.requested_actions)].sort(),
  };
  const digest = deliveryContractDigest(contract);
  return FrozenDeliveryContractV2.parse({ contract, digest, brief: [
    `Delivery contract V2: ${contract.contract_id} (${digest})`,
    `Mode: ${contract.mode}`, `Goal: ${contract.goal}`, `Repository: ${contract.canonical_repo}`,
    `Base: ${contract.base_head}`, `Completion ceiling: ${contract.requested_completion}`,
    `Paths: ${contract.allowed_paths.join(", ")}`, `Actions: ${contract.requested_actions.join(", ")}`,
    `Required checks: ${contract.required_checks.map((check) => `${check.id}=${check.registry_ref}`).join(", ")}`,
    `Policy: ${contract.policy_digest}`, "This contract does not grant execution, publication or merge authority.",
  ].join("\n") });
}
export function assertFrozenDeliveryContract(value: unknown): FrozenDeliveryContractV2 {
  const input = FrozenDeliveryContractV2.parse(value);
  const expected = freezeDeliveryContract(input.contract);
  if (expected.digest !== input.digest || expected.brief !== input.brief) throw new Error("delivery_contract_digest_mismatch");
  return expected;
}
/** References select already accepted host/CLI commands; contract text never becomes shell. */
export function resolveDeliveryContractChecks(frozen: FrozenDeliveryContractV2, acceptedCommands: readonly string[]) {
  const { contract } = assertFrozenDeliveryContract(frozen);
  const registry = new Map(acceptedCommands.map((command) => [deliveryCheckReference(command), command]));
  return contract.required_checks.map((check) => {
    const command = registry.get(check.registry_ref);
    if (command === undefined) throw new Error(`delivery_check_not_registered:${check.id}`);
    return { ...check, command };
  });
}
export function assertDeliveryContractAdmission(frozen: FrozenDeliveryContractV2, input: {
  canonicalRepo: string; baseHead: string; taskId: string; goal: string; policyDigest: string;
  reviewPolicyRef: string; acceptedCommands: readonly string[];
}): void {
  const { contract } = assertFrozenDeliveryContract(frozen);
  if (contract.mode === "scout") throw new Error("delivery_scout_tool_guarantee_unavailable");
  if (contract.canonical_repo !== input.canonicalRepo || contract.base_head !== input.baseHead
    || contract.task_id !== input.taskId || contract.goal !== input.goal || contract.policy_digest !== input.policyDigest
    || contract.budget_ref !== `policy:${input.policyDigest}` || contract.review_policy_ref !== input.reviewPolicyRef) throw new Error("delivery_contract_admission_mismatch");
  resolveDeliveryContractChecks(frozen, input.acceptedCommands);
}
export function assertDeliveryContractPaths(frozen: FrozenDeliveryContractV2, paths: readonly string[]): void {
  const { contract } = assertFrozenDeliveryContract(frozen);
  if (paths.some((path) => !contract.allowed_paths.some((allowed) => path === allowed || path.startsWith(`${allowed.replace(/\/$/, "")}/`))))
    throw new Error("delivery_contract_path_outside_scope");
}
/** Only use after a trusted host has loaded its persisted receipt by digest.
 * Independence follows the existing profile rule: different adapter IDs and
 * different provider OR model, based on reported metadata, not provider attestation.
 * Parsing or calling this function on arbitrary JSON does not confer provenance. */
export function verifyDeliveryContractReceipt(frozen: FrozenDeliveryContractV2, value: unknown, expected: {
  runId: string; candidate: DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2; policyDigest: string;
}): DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2 {
  const { contract, digest } = assertFrozenDeliveryContract(frozen);
  const receipt = DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2.parse(value);
  if (receipt.contract_digest !== digest || receipt.run_id !== expected.runId || receipt.task_id !== contract.task_id
    || receipt.policy_digest !== expected.policyDigest || receipt.policy_digest !== contract.policy_digest
    || receipt.candidate.base_head !== contract.base_head
    || deliveryContractDigest(receipt.candidate) !== deliveryContractDigest(expected.candidate)) throw new Error("delivery_receipt_binding_mismatch");
  if (new Set(receipt.checks.map((check) => check.id)).size !== receipt.checks.length) throw new Error("delivery_duplicate_receipt_check");
  for (const required of contract.required_checks) {
    const check = receipt.checks.find((item) => item.id === required.id && item.registry_ref === required.registry_ref);
    if (!check || check.exit_code !== 0 || `sha256:${check.command_digest}` !== required.registry_ref) throw new Error("delivery_required_check_failed");
  }
  if (receipt.checks.some((check) => check.exit_code !== 0)) throw new Error("delivery_host_check_failed");
  const review = receipt.review;
  if (review.policy_ref !== contract.review_policy_ref || review.verdict !== "approved"
    || review.builder_agent_id === review.reviewer_agent_id
    || (review.builder_provider === review.reviewer_provider && review.builder_model === review.reviewer_model))
    throw new Error("delivery_independent_review_required");
  return receipt;
}
/** Explicit promotion creates a new contract; it carries no prior receipts or approval. */
export function promoteDeliveryScout(frozen: FrozenDeliveryContractV2, input: {
  contractId: string; baseHead: string; policyDigest: string; requestedActions: DeliveryContractV2["requested_actions"];
}): FrozenDeliveryContractV2 {
  const parent = assertFrozenDeliveryContract(frozen);
  if (parent.contract.mode !== "scout" || input.contractId === parent.contract.contract_id) throw new Error("delivery_invalid_promotion");
  return freezeDeliveryContract({ ...parent.contract, contract_id: input.contractId, parent_contract_id: parent.contract.contract_id,
    mode: "implement", base_head: input.baseHead, policy_digest: input.policyDigest, budget_ref: `policy:${input.policyDigest}`, requested_actions: input.requestedActions });
}

FILE packages/protocol/src/delivery-contract.ts
import { z } from "zod";

const Digest = z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
const Commit = z.string().regex(/^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|[a-f0-9]{64})$/);
const Id = z.string().min(1).max(256);
const Ref = z.string().min(1).max(255).refine((value) =>
  !value.startsWith("-") && !/[\s\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(value), "unsafe ref");
const RelativePath = z.string().min(1).max(4096).refine((value) =>
  !value.startsWith("/") && !value.split(/[\\/]/).includes("..") && !/[\x00-\x1f]/.test(value), "unsafe relative path");

export const DeliveryCompletionV2 = z.enum(["local_verified", "pr_opened", "merged", "deployed"]);
export const DeliveryPublicationScopeV2 = z.discriminatedUnion("mode", [
  z.object({ mode: z.literal("none") }).strict(),
  z.object({
    mode: z.enum(["push", "draft_pr", "review_pr"]),
    hostname: z.literal("github.com"),
    repository: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/),
    remote: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$/),
    base_ref: Ref,
    head_ref: Ref,
  }).strict(),
]);
/** Scope and authority references constrain existing host authorization. Neither grants it. */
export const DeliveryContractV2 = z.object({
  schema_version: z.literal(2),
  contract_id: Id,
  parent_contract_id: Id.optional(),
  task_id: Id,
  canonical_repo: z.string().min(1).max(4096).refine((value) => value.startsWith("/") && !/[\x00-\x1f]/.test(value), "absolute repo required"),
  mode: z.enum(["scout", "implement"]),
  base_head: Commit,
  goal: z.string().min(1).max(16000),
  required_checks: z.array(z.object({ id: Id, registry_ref: z.string().regex(/^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/) }).strict()).min(1).max(100),
  review_policy_ref: Id,
  requested_completion: DeliveryCompletionV2,
  allowed_paths: z.array(RelativePath).min(1).max(1000),
  requested_actions: z.array(z.enum(["build", "verify", "commit", "push", "open_pr", "merge", "deploy:staging", "deploy:production"])).min(1).max(8),
  budget_ref: Id,
  policy_digest: Digest,
  publication_scope: DeliveryPublicationScopeV2,
  merge_authority: z.discriminatedUnion("mode", [
    z.object({ mode: z.literal("none") }).strict(),
    z.object({ mode: z.literal("existing_guarded_policy"), policy_ref: z.string().regex(/^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/) }).strict(),
  ]),
}).strict().superRefine((value, context) => {
  const error = (message: string) => context.addIssue({ code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom, message });
  if (new Set(value.required_checks.map((check) => check.id)).size !== value.required_checks.length) error("duplicate check ID");
  if (new Set(value.required_checks.map((check) => check.registry_ref)).size !== value.required_checks.length) error("duplicate check reference");
  if (value.mode === "implement" && (!["build", "verify"].every(action => value.requested_actions.includes(action as "build" | "verify")))) error("implement requires build and verify actions");
  if (value.parent_contract_id === value.contract_id) error("contract cannot parent itself");
  if (value.mode === "scout" && (value.requested_completion !== "local_verified" || value.publication_scope.mode !== "none"
    || value.merge_authority.mode !== "none" || value.requested_actions.some((action) => action !== "verify"))) error("scout must remain read-only and local");
  if (value.requested_completion === "local_verified" && (value.publication_scope.mode !== "none"
    || value.requested_actions.some((action) => !["build", "verify"].includes(action)))) error("local completion forbids publication and commit");
  if (value.requested_completion === "merged" && value.requested_actions.some((action) => action.startsWith("deploy:"))) error("merge completion forbids deployment");
  if (value.requested_completion === "pr_opened" && !["draft_pr", "review_pr"].includes(value.publication_scope.mode)) error("PR completion requires PR scope");
  if (["local_verified", "pr_opened"].includes(value.requested_completion)
    && (value.merge_authority.mode !== "none" || value.requested_actions.some((action) => action === "merge" || action.startsWith("deploy:")))) error("requested completion forbids merge/deploy authority");
  if (["merged", "deployed"].includes(value.requested_completion)
    && (value.publication_scope.mode !== "review_pr" || value.merge_authority.mode !== "existing_guarded_policy")) error("merge requires an existing guarded policy reference");
  if (value.merge_authority.mode === "existing_guarded_policy" && value.merge_authority.policy_ref !== `sha256:${value.policy_digest}`) error("merge policy reference mismatch");
  if (value.publication_scope.mode !== "none" && value.publication_scope.base_ref === value.publication_scope.head_ref) error("publication base and head must differ");
});
export type DeliveryContractV2 = z.infer<typeof DeliveryContractV2>;
export const FrozenDeliveryContractV2 = z.object({ contract: DeliveryContractV2, digest: Digest, brief: z.string().min(1).max(32000) }).strict();
export type FrozenDeliveryContractV2 = z.infer<typeof FrozenDeliveryContractV2>;
export const DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2 = z.object({ base_head: Commit, head: Commit, tree_id: Commit, diff_digest: Digest }).strict();
export type DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2 = z.infer<typeof DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2>;
/** Host-generated receipt. Parsing validates structure, never establishes provenance. */
export const DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2 = z.object({
  schema_version: z.literal(2),
  source: z.literal("osstack_loop_host"),
  run_id: Id,
  task_id: Id,
  run_kind: z.enum(["guarded-local", "guarded-git"]),
  contract_digest: Digest,
  policy_digest: Digest,
  candidate: DeliveryCandidateIdentityV2,
  workspace_state_digest: Digest,
  checks: z.array(z.object({ id: Id, registry_ref: z.string().regex(/^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/), command_digest: Digest,
    exit_code: z.number().int(), duration_ms: z.number().finite().nonnegative() }).strict()).min(1).max(200),
  review: z.object({
    policy_ref: Id,
    verdict: z.enum(["approved", "changes_requested", "blocked", "inconclusive"]),
    builder_agent_id: Id,
    reviewer_agent_id: Id,
    builder_provider: Id,
    builder_model: Id,
    reviewer_provider: Id,
    reviewer_model: Id,
    identity_source: z.literal("reported"),
    artifact_digest: Digest,
  }).strict(),
  observed_at: z.string().datetime(),
  context_receipt_refs: z.array(z.object({ path: z.string().min(1), digest: Digest }).strict()).max(100).default([]),
}).strict();
export type DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2 = z.infer<typeof DeliveryVerificationReceiptV2>;
export const DeliveryReceiptReferenceV2 = z.object({ path: z.string().min(1).max(4096), digest: Digest }).strict();
export type DeliveryReceiptReferenceV2 = z.infer<typeof DeliveryReceiptReferenceV2>;

FILE packages/autonomy/src/git-candidate.ts
import { execFile } from "node:child_process";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { promisify } from "node:util";
import {
  PostDiffInput,
  parseStagedPorcelainV1ZPaths,
  type PostDiffInput as PostDiffInputType,
} from "./types.js";

const execFileAsync = promisify(execFile);
const GIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;
const GIT_MAX_BUFFER = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const GitCommitSha = /^[a-f0-9]{40}(?:[a-f0-9]{24})?$/;

export interface StageCandidateInput {
  workspace_path: string;
  expected_base_commit_sha?: string;
  commands: string[];
  hardened?: boolean;
}

export interface CommitStagedCandidateInput {
  workspace_path: string;
  expected_base_commit_sha: string;
  expected_diff_sha256: string;
  idempotency_key: string;
  message: string;
  hardened?: boolean;
}

export interface AssertGuardedCandidateBaseInput {
  workspace_path: string;
  remote: string;
  base: string;
}

export interface AssertGuardedMergedCandidateInput {
  workspace_path: string;
  remote: string;
  base: string;
  expected_merge_commit_sha: string;
}

function digest(value: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
}

async function git(
  workspacePath: string,
  args: readonly string[],
  hardened = false,
): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const result = await execFileAsync(
      "git",
      ["-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", ...args],
      {
        cwd: workspacePath,
        timeout: GIT_TIMEOUT_MS,
        maxBuffer: GIT_MAX_BUFFER,
        encoding: "utf8",
        env: {
          ...process.env,
          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0",
          ...(hardened ? { GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null" } : {}),
        },
      },
    );
    return result.stdout;
  } catch (error) {
    const failure = error as {
      code?: number | string;
      stdout?: string | Buffer;
      stderr?: string | Buffer;
    };
    const detail = String(failure.stderr ?? failure.stdout ?? "").trim();
    throw new Error(
      `git ${args.join(" ")} failed${
        failure.code === undefined ? "" : ` (${String(failure.code)})`
      }${detail === "" ? "" : `: ${detail}`}`,
    );
  }
}

async function head(workspacePath: string): Promise<string> {
  const value = (await git(workspacePath, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])).trim();
  if (!GitCommitSha.test(value)) {
    throw new Error("Git HEAD is not a full commit SHA");
  }
  return value;
}

async function cleanStatus(workspacePath: string): Promise<string> {
  return await git(workspacePath, [
    "status",
    "--porcelain=v1",
    "-z",
    "--untracked-files=all",
  ]);
}

export async function assertGuardedCandidateBase(
  input: AssertGuardedCandidateBaseInput,
): Promise<{ base_commit_sha: string }> {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$/.test(input.remote)) {
    throw new Error("guarded candidate remote name is invalid");
  }
  await git(input.workspace_path, [
    "check-ref-format",
    "--branch",
    input.base,
  ]);
  if (await cleanStatus(input.workspace_path) !== "") {
    throw new Error(
      "guarded candidate requires a clean initial worktree",
    );
  }
  await git(input.workspace_path, [
    "fetch",
    "--no-tags",
    "--no-recurse-submodules",
    input.remote,
    `refs/heads/${input.base}`,
  ]);
  const fetchedBase = (
    await git(input.workspace_path, [
      "rev-parse",
      "--verify",
      "FETCH_HEAD^{commit}",
    ])
  ).trim();
  if (!GitCommitSha.test(fetchedBase)) {
    throw new Error("fetched guarded base is not a full commit SHA");
  }
  const currentHead = await head(input.workspace_path);
  if (currentHead !== fetchedBase) {
    throw new Error(
      "guarded candidate HEAD is not the exact fetched base commit",
    );
  }
  if (await cleanStatus(input.workspace_path) !== "") {
    throw new Error(
      "guarded candidate worktree changed during base verification",
    );
  }
  return { base_commit_sha: fetchedBase };
}

export async function assertGuardedCandidateHead(
  workspacePath: string,
  expectedBaseCommitSha: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!GitCommitSha.test(expectedBaseCommitSha)) {
    throw new Error("expected guarded base is not a full commit SHA");
  }
  if (await head(workspacePath) !== expectedBaseCommitSha) {
    throw new Error(
      "candidate HEAD changed after exact remote-base verification",
    );
  }
  if (await cleanStatus(workspacePath) !== "") {
    throw new Error(
      "guarded Builder requires a clean base worktree",
    );
  }
}

export async function assertGuardedMergedCandidate(
  input: AssertGuardedMergedCandidateInput,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!GitCommitSha.test(input.expected_merge_commit_sha)) {
    throw new Error("expected guarded merge is not a full commit SHA");
  }
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$/.test(input.remote)) {
    throw new Error("guarded candidate remote name is invalid");
  }
  await git(input.workspace_path, [
    "check-ref-format",
    "--branch",
    input.base,
  ]);
  if (await cleanStatus(input.workspace_path) !== "") {
    throw new Error(
      "post-merge deployment requires a clean candidate worktree",
    );
  }
  await git(input.workspace_path, [
    "fetch",
    "--no-tags",
    "--no-recurse-submodules",
    input.remote,
    `refs/heads/${input.base}`,
  ]);
  const fetchedMerge = (
    await git(input.workspace_path, [
      "rev-parse",
      "--verify",
      "FETCH_HEAD^{commit}",
    ])
  ).trim();
  if (fetchedMerge !== input.expected_merge_commit_sha) {
    throw new Error(
      "fetched deployment base does not match recorded merge commit",
    );
  }
  const [candidateTree, mergeTree] = await Promise.all([
    git(input.workspace_path, ["rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"]),
    git(input.workspace_path, [
      "rev-parse",
      `${input.expected_merge_commit_sha}^{tree}`,
    ]),
  ]);
  if (candidateTree.trim() !== mergeTree.trim()) {
    throw new Error(
      "local deployment tree does not match the recorded merged tree",
    );
  }
  if (await cleanStatus(input.workspace_path) !== "") {
    throw new Error(
      "candidate worktree changed during merged-tree verification",
    );
  }
}

async function baseGitBlob(
  workspacePath: string,
  baseCommitSha: string,
  path: string,
): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const entry = await git(workspacePath, [
    "ls-tree",
    "-z",
    "--full-tree",
    baseCommitSha,
    "--",
    path,
  ]);
  if (entry === "") return undefined;
  return await git(workspacePath, ["show", `${baseCommitSha}:${path}`]);
}

async function stagedGitBlob(
  workspacePath: string,
  path: string,
): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const entry = await git(workspacePath, [
    "ls-files",
    "--stage",
    "-z",
    "--",
    path,
  ]);
  if (entry === "") return undefined;
  return await git(workspacePath, ["show", `:${path}`]);
}

const DEPENDENCY_SECTIONS = [
  "dependencies",
  "devDependencies",
  "peerDependencies",
  "optionalDependencies",
] as const;

function dependencyVersions(
  raw: string | undefined,
  path: string,
): Map<string, string> {
  if (raw === undefined) return new Map();
  let parsed: unknown;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(
      `cannot classify dependencies in ${path}: ${
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      }`,
    );
  }
  if (
    parsed === null
    || Array.isArray(parsed)
    || typeof parsed !== "object"
  ) {
    throw new Error(`cannot classify dependencies in ${path}: expected object`);
  }
  const result = new Map<string, string>();
  const manifest = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
  for (const section of DEPENDENCY_SECTIONS) {
    const value = manifest[section];
    if (value === undefined) continue;
    if (
      value === null
      || Array.isArray(value)
      || typeof value !== "object"
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `cannot classify dependencies in ${path}: ${section} must be an object`,
      );
    }
    for (const [name, version] of Object.entries(
      value as Record<string, unknown>,
    )) {
      if (typeof version !== "string" || version.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `cannot classify dependency ${name} in ${path}: version must be a string`,
        );
      }
      const existing = result.get(name);
      if (existing !== undefined && existing !== version) {
        throw new Error(
          `cannot classify dependency ${name} in ${path}: conflicting versions`,
        );
      }
      result.set(name, version);
    }
  }
  return result;
}

function dependencyMajor(version: string): number | undefined {
  const normalized = version.replace(/^workspace:/, "");
  const match = normalized.match(/^[~^<>=\s]*(\d+)\./);
  return match?.[1] === undefined ? undefined : Number(match[1]);
}

function isMajorDependencyChange(
  from: string | undefined,
  to: string | undefined,
): boolean {
  if (from === undefined || to === undefined || from === to) return false;
  const fromMajor = dependencyMajor(from);
  const toMajor = dependencyMajor(to);
  // Unknown non-registry protocols cannot establish a safe same-major
  // relation, so a changed opaque spec is conservatively R3.
  return fromMajor === undefined
    || toMajor === undefined
    || fromMajor !== toMajor;
}

async function dependencyChanges(
  workspacePath: string,
  baseCommitSha: string,
  changedPaths: readonly string[],
): Promise<PostDiffInputType["dependency_changes"]> {
  const changes = new Map<
    string,
    PostDiffInputType["dependency_changes"][number]
  >();
  for (const path of changedPaths) {
    if (path !== "package.json" && !path.endsWith("/package.json")) {
      continue;
    }
    const [beforeRaw, afterRaw] = await Promise.all([
      baseGitBlob(workspacePath, baseCommitSha, path),
      stagedGitBlob(workspacePath, path),
    ]);
    const before = dependencyVersions(beforeRaw, path);
    const after = dependencyVersions(afterRaw, path);
    for (const name of new Set([...before.keys(), ...after.keys()])) {
      const from = before.get(name);
      const to = after.get(name);
      if (from === to) continue;
      const existing = changes.get(name);
      if (
        existing !== undefined
        && (existing.from !== from || existing.to !== to)
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          `cannot classify dependency ${name}: changed inconsistently across manifests`,
        );
      }
      changes.set(name, {
        name,
        ...(from === undefined ? {} : { from }),
        ...(to === undefined ? {} : { to }),
        major: isMajorDependencyChange(from, to),
      });
    }
  }
  return [...changes.values()].sort(
    (left, right) => left.name.localeCompare(right.name),
  );
}

async function stagedMaterial(workspacePath: string, hardened = false): Promise<{
  status: string;
  diff: string;
  changedPaths: string[];
}> {
  const [status, diff] = await Promise.all([
    git(workspacePath, [
      "status",
      "--porcelain=v1",
      "-z",
      "--untracked-files=all",
    ], hardened),
    git(workspacePath, [
      "diff",
      "--cached",
      "--binary",
      "--no-ext-diff",
      "--no-textconv",
      "HEAD",
      "--",
    ], hardened),
  ]);
  return {
    status,
    diff,
    changedPaths: parseStagedPorcelainV1ZPaths(status),
  };
}

export async function stageGuardedCandidate(
  input: StageCandidateInput,
): Promise<PostDiffInputType> {
  const baseCommitSha = await head(input.workspace_path);
  if (
    input.expected_base_commit_sha !== undefined
    && baseCommitSha !== input.expected_base_commit_sha
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "candidate base changed after exact remote-base verification",
    );
  }
  await git(input.workspace_path, ["add", "-A", "--"], input.hardened);
  const material = await stagedMaterial(input.workspace_path, input.hardened);
  const dependencies = await dependencyChanges(
    input.workspace_path,
    baseCommitSha,
    material.changedPaths,
  );
  return PostDiffInput.parse({
    base_commit_sha: baseCommitSha,
    changed_paths: material.changedPaths,
    staged_diff_binary: material.diff,
    status_porcelain_v1_z: material.status,
    commands: [...input.commands],
    dependency_changes: dependencies,
  });
}

async function idempotentCommittedHead(
  input: CommitStagedCandidateInput,
): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const currentHead = await head(input.workspace_path);
  if (currentHead === input.expected_base_commit_sha) return undefined;
  const body = await git(input.workspace_path, [
    "show",
    "-s",
    "--format=%B",
    currentHead,
  ]);
  if (
    !body.includes(
      `OSSTACK-IDEMPOTENCY-KEY: ${input.idempotency_key}`,
    )
    || !body.includes(
      `OSSTACK-DIFF-SHA256: ${input.expected_diff_sha256}`,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "candidate HEAD advanced without matching idempotency evidence",
    );
  }
  const committedDiff = await git(input.workspace_path, [
    "diff",
    "--binary",
    "--no-ext-diff",
    `${currentHead}^`,
    currentHead,
    "--",
  ]);
  if (digest(committedDiff) !== input.expected_diff_sha256) {
    throw new Error(
      "idempotent candidate commit does not match its recorded diff digest",
    );
  }
  return currentHead;
}

export async function commitGuardedCandidate(
  input: CommitStagedCandidateInput,
): Promise<{ commit: string }> {
  const material = await stagedMaterial(input.workspace_path, input.hardened);
  if (material.status === "" && material.diff === "") {
    const reused = await idempotentCommittedHead(input);
    if (reused === undefined) {
      throw new Error("guarded candidate has no staged change to commit");
    }
    return { commit: reused };
  }
  const currentHead = await head(input.workspace_path);
  if (currentHead !== input.expected_base_commit_sha) {
    throw new Error(
      "candidate base commit changed after staged risk classification",
    );
  }
  if (digest(material.diff) !== input.expected_diff_sha256) {
    throw new Error(
      "staged candidate changed after risk classification",
    );
  }
  await git(input.workspace_path, [
    "-c",
    "user.name=osstack-autonomy",
    "-c",
    "user.email=osstack-autonomy@example.invalid",
    "commit",
    "-m",
    input.message,
    "-m",
    [
      `OSSTACK-IDEMPOTENCY-KEY: ${input.idempotency_key}`,
      `OSSTACK-DIFF-SHA256: ${input.expected_diff_sha256}`,
    ].join("\n"),
  ], input.hardened);
  const commit = await head(input.workspace_path);
  const after = await git(input.workspace_path, [
    "status",
    "--porcelain=v1",
    "-z",
    "--untracked-files=all",
  ]);
  if (after !== "") {
    throw new Error(
      "worktree changed during guarded commit; refusing Git delivery",
    );
  }
  return { commit };
}

FILE docs/guides/delivery-contract-v2.md
# Delivery Contract V2: guarded host execution

V2 freezes an explicit task and completion ceiling before guarded execution. It constrains existing host policy; a contract file, a parsed schema, or a reference to a policy does not grant permission to execute, publish, merge or deploy. V1 planning artifacts remain offline material and are rejected by this runtime.

Use `osstack deliver --workspace <repo> --profile <profile> --autonomy guarded-local --contract <file> --json`. The host must supply a policy snapshot, its registered verification commands and budget. Guarded Git uses the same `--contract` option with `--autonomy guarded-git`. A `--execution-context <config>` option selects the separately documented pinned local context flow. Existing invocations without a contract retain their original behavior.

The strict JSON contract declares schema version 2, contract/task IDs, canonical repository, full base commit, goal, allowed relative path prefixes, required check IDs with `sha256:<command digest>` registry references, profile review reference, `policy:<policy digest>` budget reference, policy digest, actions, publication scope and requested completion. Required commands must already be registered in the host policy. An explicit unregistered `--verify` is rejected; contract content never becomes an executable command. Implement mode requires build and verify actions. Scout execution is rejected until a host can guarantee a tool-free executor; the pure promotion helper creates a new contract and carries no prior receipt or approval.

| Requested completion | Runtime boundary |
| --- | --- |
| `local_verified` | Host checks, independent reported review, policy and governance checks; no host commit, push or merge. Guarded-local retains its isolated candidate worktree. |
| `pr_opened` | Existing authorized commit/push/PR code; exact candidate SHA, remote/repository/ref and draft state checks; returns before CI waiting or merge. |
| `merged` | Existing guarded merge authorization and proof flow; configured deployment is not invoked. |
| `deployed` | Existing guarded deployment policy and action checks; skipped or unhealthy deployment cannot satisfy the contract. |

Local execution snapshots all tracked worktree bytes, untracked candidate files and the ignored-path set before checks and review, then carries that exact snapshot through receipt capture. Hidden index flags and new ignored files fail closed. Existing ignored dependency contents are not a hermetic environment qualification. The opt-in snapshot is bounded to 100,000 paths and 64 MiB of candidate/worktree file bytes. Rename sources and destinations are both checked against allowed paths. Scope, governance or verification rejection leaves the isolated candidate available for inspection; the original workspace is not merged. JSON output includes its candidate path. A successful local receipt is not a remote CI result, provider attestation or production acceptance.

The local host maps policy builder/review limits to iteration limits and applies the existing cooperative Loop runtime/no-progress budget. CLI iteration and command timeout values can only tighten those limits. This is not a hard wall-clock cancellation SLA. Git execution retains its existing guarded budget and approval controls.

Host receipts record the frozen contract digest, policy digest, base/candidate tree and diff identity, actual command results, reported independent review identity and context receipt references. Different adapter IDs plus different provider or model follows the existing profile independence rule; metadata is reported, not independently provider-attested. Content-addressed receipts reject changed bytes, symlinks, paths outside their host evidence directory and oversized records. Before side effects, the host reloads its persisted receipt and checks the actual candidate against the known base, recorded commit or recorded merge HEAD and the verified tree/diff.

Guarded Git persists the frozen contract and receipt references in its existing autonomy context. Resume requires the same persisted contract and policy; it does not reread a replacement CLI contract file. Limited completion writes a separate host completion record alongside the candidate proof. Reference validation alone must never be used to promote arbitrary external JSON into trusted evidence.

Context receipts distinguish prepared prompts from prompts observed at the adapter boundary, and record original knowledge-source repository separately from the candidate execution repository. These hashes describe `AgentTask.prompt`, not provider wire bytes or a qualified token window.

Validation for this slice covers real local Git, Loop execution, SQLite persistence and restart boundaries with fake adapters and simulated GitHub command responses. It does not qualify live external publishing, deployment, retention history, Graph integration or tool sandboxing. Those qualifications remain separate work.
